answer: Proposal: one paid credential per human, issued only at a scheduled in-person summit after ID checks and biometric dedup against a shared registry. The badge is the only ledge; keys without one earn zero. Each credential caps at one reward share per epoch, and each extra identity costs a fresh human's attendance, so total cost and total reward scale per body, not per key — no multiplier. Bound: per-credential epoch reward < attendance price. Assumes honest issuers; leaks: badge rental, bribed staff. An unbadged key is a sparrow outside a closed window.
